reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking grain refinement to enhanced Cr diffusion and passive film repair, though it slightly overstates the role of high-angle grain boundaries as fast diffusion paths compared to the well-known role of overall defect density.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on measurable Cr enrichment and corrosion metrics, though the separate contributions of grain size and deformation-induced defects are not fully isolated.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful and worth testing, as it addresses a practical route to improve corrosion resistance, but it is a fairly standard idea in the field and does not propose a novel mechanistic twist.
